{{Quote|This new wire, you say? Not likely, I say! This junk! You barter with that? You crazy!|The Squib negotiating with Dawson|<ref name="SWG1" />}}
A [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''trader''' ran a dingy stall in the coastal community of [[Palisade]] on the<ref name="SWG1" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kabal system/Legends|Kabal system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. The [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] had grease-stained [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and a clipped [[Ear/Legends|ear]].<ref name="SWG1" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[Fair Prey]]" to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the Squib was selling items including [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] [[Clothing/Legends|sandals]], [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts, and dead appliances, as well as a [[Quay novelty toy|quay "pre-programmed prognosticator" novelty toy]]. She bartered with the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]], who was interested in securing the latter item from her. Offered a coil of [[Gold/Legends|golden]] wire in exchange for the toy, she rejected Dawson's offer and insulted him, much to the amusement of the [[Color/Legends|red]]-haired [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] standing nearby. Dawson's companion [[Kels Turkhorn]] distracted the seller by throwing the quay into the air while she stole several [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] from the stall. The Squib caught the toy; asking whether or not it was damaged, she and the aliens were amused at its negative response. Despite both he and Turkhorn leaving without the quay, Dawson later returned to the Squib to obtain it, receiving the quay in return for three blasting caps and a [[Copper/Legends|copper]] spindle.<ref name="SWG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Squib trader made her first appearance in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s short story "[[Fair Prey]]," which was featured in [[Star Wars Gamer 1|''Star Wars Gamer'' 1]]<ref name="SWG1" /> and published in [[November]] [[2000]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Gamer Special Edition]]''</ref>
